Right Hilary Baxter who has slaughtered Club records at 800m, 1500m and 1 mile.

At the other end of the age range Alan Black ran a smooth 4.36 for our fastest vet, pipping Laurie O'Hara by 1 second. Hilary Baxter was our fastest lady. The disappointing aspect was the large number who failed to appear on the day.

I must also mention Hilary Baxter who has always run well, and has set some first class club records in the 800 and 1500m. Last of the athletes I should like to thank Jackie Barclay for the help she has given me during this Season.
